issue.title: Review execution.md write in restart marker mutation-audit fixture
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-yy.8.4 note #2 and confirmed during sase-yy.8 landing at 8eabf9ecf. tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_mutation_audit.py::test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_match_expected_mutations fails deterministically because the expected mutation-call tuple for src/sase/agent/_restart_recovery.py:_write_recovery_files omits a write_text call. Commit 63a5dbef1 added execution.md to the recovery bundle without updating this fixture. Inspect that new write, verify that it remains in the exempt recovery snapshot directory rather than the indexed live artifact tree, and update the reviewed tuple and exemption text if warranted. Preserve the runtime write and the audit's strictness; do not loosen the audit globally.

The full audit module failed at this node, then the exact node failed again on the unchanged tree (19.23s). Evidence: file:explicit:79c7e830663c8ae43883564f. The nearby provider-drain wait-pragma failure from the same source commit is already task sase-zh, but it requires a different fix in a different fixture. Searched ci tasks, broader task types, the last-week task list, all active epic scopes, and plausible provider-disable epic sase-mc; this defect came from the separate grok_drain_relaunch_repair tale, not that old provider-disable epic. No semantic duplicate or causally owning active epic was found.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Two unchanged-tree failures compare a deterministic AST mutation-call sequence with a stale literal tuple; commit 63a5dbef1 added one write_text call.
